evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.description: Offline sets, online metrics, and judge models — measure before you ship prompt vibes.

steps.heading: Eval case
steps.caption: Gold set — freeze examples that encode what “good” means for your product.

steps.heading: Slice scores on vNext prompt
steps.caption: Score — automatic checks where possible; rubric/judge where language varies.

steps.heading: Baseline vs candidate (policy correctness)
steps.caption: Compare — never look at a single prompt in isolation; diff against the current production baseline.

steps.heading: Release gate
steps.caption: Gate deploys — ship only if the candidate wins on critical slices and does not regress safety.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Traces that reconstruct a generation: prompts, retrieval, tools, tokens, and outcomes.

steps.heading: Trace
steps.caption: One request, many spans — API, retrieve, rerank, generate, tools each get timing and attributes.

steps.heading: Trace attributes
steps.caption: Link evidence — store retrieved chunk ids so you can see whether a wrong answer was a miss or an ignore.

steps.heading: Data handling
steps.caption: Privacy — raw prompts may contain PII. Hash, redact, or sample under policy.

steps.heading: Loop
steps.caption: From traces to action — aggregate failure tags weekly; feed new cases into the eval set.

security-privacy.title: Security and privacy
security-privacy.description: Prompt injection, data exfiltration via tools, and PII in logs — threat model the LLM boundary.

steps.heading: Indirect injection
steps.caption: Prompt injection — hostile content in a document tries to override instructions when retrieved.

steps.heading: Hardening
steps.caption: Controls — separate untrusted content, strip tool-triggering instructions, and require human approval for sensitive tools.

steps.heading: Where PII leaks (illustrative incidents)
steps.caption: PII — minimise what enters prompts and logs; encrypt stores; honour retention.

steps.heading: Egress scan hits
steps.caption: Secrets — models invent looking-like keys; scanners should catch both real and accidental disclosures outbound.

hallucination-mitigation.title: Hallucination mitigation
hallucination-mitigation.description: Reduce unsupported claims with grounding, abstention, and verification — not wishful temperature settings alone.

steps.heading: Ungrounded claim
steps.caption: Symptom — fluent answer with no supporting passage in context.

steps.heading: Policy
steps.caption: Cite-or-abstain — require chunk ids; if none apply, say you do not know.

steps.heading: Verify loop
steps.caption: Verify — for numbers and statuses, call a tool of record instead of believing the prose.

steps.heading: Unsupported claim rate
steps.caption: Measure — hallucination rate on a labeled set; track online “unsupported citation” tags.

production-guardrails.title: Production guardrails
production-guardrails.description: Layered filters in the live path — input, tool, and output — with metrics on blocks.

steps.heading: Live path
steps.caption: Pipeline placement — gates surround the model, not only live inside the system prompt.

steps.heading: Blocks / day
steps.caption: Block reasons — taxonomy lets you tune false positives without disabling everything.

steps.heading: Policy
steps.caption: Fail modes — fail closed on payments/exfil; fail open carefully on low-risk UX with monitoring.

steps.heading: Rule deploy
steps.caption: Change management — guardrail rules are code; review, version, and eval them like prompts.

cost-optimization.title: Cost optimization
cost-optimization.description: Tokens, model tiering, caching, and retrieval size — cut spend without blind quality loss.

steps.heading: Weekly spend split (illustrative)
steps.caption: Bill shape — output tokens often cost more per token; long digressions are expensive.

steps.heading: Model router
steps.caption: Tiering — classifier/router sends easy asks to a small model; hard asks to a large one.

steps.heading: Cache hit rate vs spend
steps.caption: Cache — identical system prompts and hot retrieved docs can be cached at HTTP or prompt-prefix layers when the provider supports it.

steps.heading: Quality vs $ per 1k requests
steps.caption: Context diet — fewer chunks and tighter instructions often save more than shaving 5°C of temperature.

latency-scaling.title: Latency and scaling
latency-scaling.description: TTFT, tokens/sec, batching, and horizontal scale — what actually moves p95.

steps.heading: p95 breakdown
steps.caption: Break down latency — find whether you are waiting on queue, prefill, or decode.

steps.heading: TTFT vs input tokens
steps.caption: Input length hurts prefill — RAG stuffing can dominate TTFT before the first token streams.

steps.heading: What scaling fixes
steps.caption: Scale out — more replicas cut queue time; they do not speed a single decode chain.

steps.heading: Latency toolkit
steps.caption: Knobs — smaller models, fewer input tokens, speculative decoding / provider features, streaming for perceived speed.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Retries, idempotency, deadlines, and degraded modes when providers wobble.

steps.heading: Retry policy
steps.caption: Transient errors — 429/5xx may deserve retry; 400/auth errors do not.

steps.heading: Refund with key
steps.caption: Idempotency keys — tool side effects survive retries without duplication.

steps.heading: Time budget
steps.caption: Deadlines — a 30s client timeout with 3×20s retries is a lie; bound the whole tree.

steps.heading: Fallback
steps.caption: Degraded mode — serve a smaller model or partial RAG rather than hard 500s when the primary is down.

best-practices-checklist.title: Production best-practices checklist
best-practices-checklist.description: A compact operating checklist spanning evals, traces, safety, cost, and change control.

steps.heading: Quality bar
steps.caption: Quality — versioned prompts, golden sets, deploy gates.

steps.heading: Safety bar
steps.caption: Safety — allowlists, HITL on irreversible tools, egress scanners.

steps.heading: Ops bar
steps.caption: Ops — traces, budgets, SLOs, incident runbooks for provider outages.

steps.heading: Example team scorecard
steps.caption: Score yourself honestly — ship the missing high-severity items before the next feature.
